settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous robot-factory scenes. Conveyor state, robot count, battery cells, switches and doors persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP08 — โรงงานหุ่นยนต์วุ่นวาย
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่โรงงานหุ่นยนต์ที่ระบบทำงานผิดจังหวะ ต้องหยุดสายพาน ช่วยหุ่นซ่อมบำรุงตัวเล็ก หาแบตเตอรี่สองก้อน เปิดห้องควบคุม และรีเซ็ตระบบอย่างปลอดภัยก่อนกลับ
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous robot-factory adventure. Exact brother identities fixed. Robot positions, conveyor state, batteries, switches and opened doors must persist without reset.

scenes.title: โรงงานทำงานผิดจังหวะ
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive at bright robot factory entrance; conveyor ahead moves too fast but safely enclosed.
scenes.mainAction: older brother notices warning lights and fast conveyor

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ระบบมันเร็วผิดปกติ

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, bright blocky factory, one conveyor, no readable UI text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Push toward conveyor. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand beside emergency control pedestal; conveyor still moving fast; small maintenance robot visible behind barrier.

scenes.title: หยุดสายพาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Conveyor moving fast; brothers beside emergency pedestal.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother presses plain stop button once

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: หยุดก่อนดีกว่า

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same pedestal and conveyor. Younger presses one plain button.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close button then pan to conveyor slowing. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Conveyor fully stopped; stop button active; maintenance robot remains behind barrier; side gate unlocks.

scenes.title: หุ่นซ่อมบำรุง
scenes.continuityStartState: Conveyor stopped; side gate unlocked; maintenance robot behind barrier.
scenes.mainAction: brothers enter side lane and approach one small robot with low battery light

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มันแบตหมดแน่เลย

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and exactly one small maintenance robot. Conveyor remains stopped behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into lane. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers kneel beside robot; two empty battery slots visible; robot stationary.

scenes.title: ต้องหาแบตสองก้อน
scenes.continuityStartState: Robot stationary with two empty slots; brothers beside it.
scenes.mainAction: older brother points to two empty slots and nearby storage paths

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ต้องหาอีกสองก้อน

scenes.imageDescription: Same robot and slots. Two side storage routes visible, no text labels.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium puzzle reveal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand; older chooses left storage aisle first; robot remains stationary with empty slots.

scenes.title: แบตก้อนแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers enter left aisle; robot stays behind with two empty slots.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother finds one blue battery cell on low shelf

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เจอหนึ่งก้อน

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers; exactly one battery cell on shelf. Younger picks it up.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close pickup shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger carries battery cell; shelf now empty; both turn back toward robot.

scenes.title: ใส่แบตแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger carries first battery; robot still has two empty slots.
scenes.mainAction: younger inserts battery into left slot

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เหลืออีกก้อน

scenes.imageDescription: Same robot. First battery moves from younger hand into left slot; right slot remains empty.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close insertion then robot light partially activates. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Left slot filled, right slot empty; robot still stationary; brothers face right storage aisle.

scenes.title: ทางสายพานเล็ก
scenes.continuityStartState: First battery installed; brothers enter right aisle.
scenes.mainAction: older brother spots second battery beyond a small stationary conveyor section

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: อยู่ฝั่งโน้น

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers, one second battery visible beyond stopped mini-conveyor. Main factory conveyor remains stopped globally.
scenes.videoPrompt: Over-shoulder reveal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand before stationary mini-conveyor; second battery across it; safe stepping blocks visible.

scenes.title: ข้ามบล็อก
scenes.continuityStartState: Second battery across stationary mini-conveyor; stepping blocks visible.
scenes.mainAction: older brother crosses first two blocks and younger follows
scenes.imageDescription: Same aisle and battery position. Older leads, younger follows; conveyor remains stopped.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side follow across blocks. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach far side beside second battery; stepping blocks behind unchanged.

scenes.title: แบตก้อนสอง
scenes.continuityStartState: Both beside second battery on far side.
scenes.mainAction: older brother picks up second battery
scenes.imageDescription: Same battery picked up once; shelf/pedestal empty afterward.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium pickup. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older carries second battery; both face route back across same stationary conveyor.

scenes.title: กลับไปหาหุ่น
scenes.continuityStartState: Older carries second battery; first battery already installed in robot.
scenes.mainAction: brothers return to robot via same aisle

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เอาไปใส่กัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers walking back, older still carrying battery. Robot ahead with left slot filled.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers kneel beside robot; older holds battery at empty right slot.

scenes.title: หุ่นกลับมาทำงาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Older holds second battery at empty right slot; first slot filled.
scenes.mainAction: older inserts second battery and robot powers on
scenes.imageDescription: Second battery goes into right slot; both slots filled; one robot activates, no duplicates.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close insertion then widen to robot waking. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Robot powered on and points toward control-room door; both batteries remain installed.

scenes.title: ตามหุ่นไป
scenes.continuityStartState: Robot powered and pointing toward control-room door.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มันกำลังพาเราไป

scenes.imageDescription: Same one robot leads; same brothers follow; factory conveyor still stopped behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow behind trio. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Robot stops at locked control-room door and extends access arm; brothers stand behind.

scenes.title: เปิดห้องควบคุม
scenes.continuityStartState: Robot at locked door with access arm extended; brothers behind.
scenes.mainAction: robot touches access panel and door opens

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: มันเปิดให้เราแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same robot opens one control door; no readable access text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Panel-to-door pan. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Control-room door fully open; robot waits outside; brothers face central reset lever inside.

scenes.title: รีเซ็ตระบบ
scenes.continuityStartState: Door open; robot outside; central reset lever ahead.
scenes.mainAction: both brothers pull large lever together
scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers share one lever; factory status lights change from chaotic to steady, no text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium teamwork shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Reset complete; conveyor resumes at normal slow speed; robot lights steady; return portal activates near exit.

scenes.title: โรงงานกลับปกติ
scenes.continuityStartState: Factory reset complete; conveyor slow normal; robot powered; portal active.
scenes.mainAction: brothers observe calm factory and wave to maintenance robot

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: กลับมาปกติแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same factory final state, one robot only, slow conveyor, brothers beside active portal.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow arc across factory to brothers. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand side-by-side facing return portal; robot behind them functioning normally.

scenes.title: ออกจากโรงงาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Both face active return portal; factory stable behind.
scenes.imageDescription: Canonical brothers enter one portal; robot and factory remain in repaired state behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; factory remains stable; episode complete.
